sentences.text_target: Tom checks the weather forecast for the weekend.
sentences.phonetic: tɒm tʃɛks ðə ˈwɛðə ˈfɔːkɑːst fɔː ðə ˈwiːkɛnd.
sentences.text_native: Tom consulte les prévisions météo pour le week-end.

sentences.text_target: He wants to plan a nice trip outside.
sentences.phonetic: hi wɒnts tu plæn ə naɪs trɪp ˈaʊtsaɪd.
sentences.text_native: Il veut planifier une belle sortie dehors.

sentences.text_target: Today the sky is very grey and cloudy.
sentences.phonetic: təˈdeɪ ðə skaɪ ɪz ˈvɛri ɡreɪ ənd ˈklaʊdi.
sentences.text_native: Aujourd'hui le ciel est très gris et nuageux.

sentences.text_target: A big thunderstorm starts in the morning.
sentences.phonetic: ə bɪɡ ˈθʌndəstɔːm stɑːts ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ.
sentences.text_native: Un gros orage commence le matin.

sentences.text_target: He sees strong wind and heavy rain drops.
sentences.phonetic: hi siːz strɒŋ wɪnd ənd ˈhɛvi reɪn drɒps.
sentences.text_native: Il voit un vent fort et de grosses gouttes de pluie.

sentences.text_target: Lightning appears quickly behind the dark trees.
sentences.phonetic: ˈlaɪtnɪŋ əˈpɪəz ˈkwɪkli bɪˈhaɪnd ðə dɑːk triːz.
sentences.text_native: Des éclairs apparaissent rapidement derrière les arbres sombres.

sentences.text_target: Tom understands he cannot wear his summer clothes.
sentences.phonetic: tɒm ˌʌndəˈstændz hi ˈkænɒt wɛə hɪz ˈsʌmə kləʊðz.
sentences.text_native: Tom comprend qu'il ne peut pas porter ses vêtements d'été.

sentences.text_target: He stays at home for his indoor activities.
sentences.phonetic: hi steɪz ət həʊm fɔː hɪz ˈɪndɔː ækˈtɪvɪtiz.
sentences.text_native: Il reste à la maison pour ses activités en intérieur.

sentences.text_target: First, he wants to read a good book.
sentences.phonetic: fɜːst, hi wɒnts tu riːd ə ɡʊd bʊk.
sentences.text_native: D'abord, il veut lire un bon livre.

sentences.text_target: He sits on the comfortable sofa near the window.
sentences.phonetic: hi sɪts ɒn ðə ˈkʌmfətəbl ˈsəʊfə nɪə ðə ˈwɪndəʊ.
sentences.text_native: Il s'assoit sur le canapé confortable près de la fenêtre.

sentences.text_target: The cold weather makes him want hot tea.
sentences.phonetic: ðə kəʊld ˈwɛðə meɪks hɪm wɒnt hɒt tiː.
sentences.text_native: Le temps froid lui donne envie de thé chaud.

sentences.text_target: He goes to the kitchen to prepare it.
sentences.phonetic: hi ɡəʊz tu ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn tu prɪˈpeə ɪt.
sentences.text_native: Il va dans la cuisine pour le préparer.

sentences.text_target: Then, he decides to cook some warm soup.
sentences.phonetic: ðɛn, hi dɪˈsaɪdz tu kʊk sʌm wɔːm suːp.
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il décide de cuisiner de la soupe chaude.

sentences.text_target: The kitchen smells very delicious during the process.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn smɛlz ˈvɛri dɪˈlɪʃəs ˈdjʊərɪŋ ðə ˈprəʊsɛs.
sentences.text_native: La cuisine sent très bon pendant la préparation.

sentences.text_target: He eats his meal while looking at the landscape.
sentences.phonetic: hi iːts hɪz miːl waɪl ˈlʊkɪŋ æt ðə ˈlændskeɪp.
sentences.text_native: Il prend son repas en regardant le paysage.

sentences.text_target: The ground outside is completely wet from the water.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ɡraʊnd ˈaʊtsaɪd ɪz kəmˈpliːtli wɛt frɒm ðə ˈwɔːtə.
sentences.text_native: Le sol dehors est complètement mouillé par l'eau.

sentences.text_target: No birds fly in the sky right now.
sentences.phonetic: nəʊ bɜːdz flaɪ ɪn ðə skaɪ raɪt naʊ.
sentences.text_native: Aucun oiseau ne vole dans le ciel en ce moment.

sentences.text_target: After a few hours, the rain finally stops.
sentences.phonetic: ˈɑːftər ə fjuː ˈaʊəz, ðə reɪn ˈfaɪnəli stɒps.
sentences.text_native: Après quelques heures, la pluie s'arrête enfin.

sentences.text_target: The sun begins to shine very bright.
sentences.phonetic: ðə sʌn bɪˈɡɪnz tu ʃaɪn ˈvɛri braɪt.
sentences.text_native: Le soleil commence à briller très fort.

sentences.text_target: Tom opens the door and breathes fresh air.
sentences.phonetic: tɒm ˈəʊpənz ðə dɔːr ənd briːðz frɛʃ eə.
sentences.text_native: Tom ouvre la porte et respire l'air frais.

sentences.text_target: He puts on his comfortable walking shoes.
sentences.phonetic: hi pʊts ɒn hɪz ˈkʌmfətəbl ˈwɔːkɪŋ ʃuːz.
sentences.text_native: Il met ses chaussures de marche confortables.

sentences.text_target: He takes a light jacket just in case.
sentences.phonetic: hi teɪks ə laɪt ˈʤækɪt ʤʌst ɪn keɪs.
sentences.text_native: Il prend une veste légère juste au cas où.

sentences.text_target: He walks towards the local public park.
sentences.phonetic: hi wɔːks təˈwɔːdz ðə ˈləʊkəl ˈpʌblɪk pɑːk.
sentences.text_native: Il marche vers le parc public du quartier.

sentences.text_target: The trees look very clean in the afternoon light.
sentences.phonetic: ðə triːz lʊk ˈvɛri kliːn ɪn ði ˈɑːftənuːn laɪt.
sentences.text_native: Les arbres ont l'air très propres sous la lumière de l'après-midi.

sentences.text_target: Some brown leaves fall slowly on the grass.
sentences.phonetic: sʌm braʊn liːvz fɔːl ˈsləʊli ɒn ðə ɡrɑːs.
sentences.text_native: Quelques feuilles brunes tombent lentement sur l'herbe.

sentences.text_target: He meets his good friend near the big tree.
sentences.phonetic: hi miːts hɪz ɡʊd frɛnd nɪə ðə bɪɡ triː.
sentences.text_native: Il rencontre son bon ami près du grand arbre.

sentences.text_target: They talk about the changing weather this month.
sentences.phonetic: ðeɪ tɔːk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈʧeɪnʤɪŋ ˈwɛðə ðɪs mʌnθ.
sentences.text_native: Ils parlent du temps changeant ce mois-ci.

sentences.text_target: Tomorrow will be another sunny and warm day.
sentences.phonetic: təˈmɒrəʊ wɪl bi əˈnʌðə ˈsʌni ənd wɔːm deɪ.
sentences.text_native: Demain sera une autre journée ensoleillée et chaude.

sentences.text_target: In the evening, Tom returns happily home.
sentences.phonetic: ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ, tɒm rɪˈtɜːnz ˈhæpɪli həʊm.
sentences.text_native: Le soir, Tom rentre chez lui avec le sourire.

sentences.text_target: He goes to bed and sleeps very well.
sentences.phonetic: hi ɡəʊz tu bɛd ənd sliːps ˈvɛri wɛl.
sentences.text_native: Il va se coucher et dort très bien.
